summary: Builds a candidate path by copying the caller-supplied path into a local buffer and appending a fixed 5-byte extension read from globals dword_5BE868 + byte_5BE86C, then probes file existence with ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API using FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL (128). If the attribute query fails (-1) it returns 1; on success it reallocates a copy of the path via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and clears the caller struct fields this+0x8 and this+0xC to -1 and this+0x10 to 0, returning 0. Returns 1 immediately when the input path a1 is null.

local_names.a1: caller-supplied file path to extend and test
local_names.a2: caller struct whose fields are cleared on successful existence check
local_names.v3: single-byte suffix read from global byte_5BE86C
local_names.v4: cursor at the end of the copied path where the extension is appended

operations.description: If input path a1 is null, return 1 immediately without probing
Copy a1 into the local FileName buffer with a 250-character cap via sub_587DD0, then null-terminate at index 250
Append the 5-byte file extension at the end of the copied path: first 4 bytes from dword_5BE868, 1 trailing byte from byte_5BE86C
Probe the built path with ToggleFileReadOnlyAttributeViaWin32API using attribute flag 128 (FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL); -1 signals the file does not exist
If the attribute probe returned -1 (file missing), return 1
On success, copy the validated FileName into a reallocated buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc
Reset caller struct outputs: write -1 to this+0x8 and this+0xC, and 0 to this+0x10
Return 0 when the file exists and the struct fields were reset; all failure paths return 1
